coverage.reason: Existing native viewer controls are retained.
No stored preferences or gameplay state change.
Only local same-origin authored GLB assets are loaded; no auth changes.
Art viewer never joins a gameplay room.
Prebuilt geometry and async shader compilation replace startup geometry generation.
Existing reduced-motion and controls must work while assets load.
Compare original geometry, animation samples and GLB resource sizes.
Use established Three.js GLTF loading and keyframe optimization.

direct.name: three
direct.compatibility: Existing locked Three.js 0.182.0 and matching addons. No added dependencies.
direct.ownership: Authoring owns geometry and clips; GLTFLoader owns decoding; viewer owns lifecycle, controls and shader preparation.

behavior.behavior: Load GLB assets with existing GLTFLoader; retain their scene hierarchy and animation. KeyframeTrack.optimize removes redundant constant keys.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy example styling, environment textures or camera. Preserve accepted characters and silent art scope.

platform.requirement: compileAsync prepares materials using parallel shader compilation when supported. Yield before initial upload; no guaranteed device FPS claim.

proof: Silent browser art inspection of loaded GLBs at shot and resting poses
